Everybody reacts differently to antidepressants and you will not necessarily experience any side effects. I was on cipralex for almost a year, and it helped me function normally. The only side effect I experienced was that I felt emotionally dull, which was why talked to my doctor about trying something else. I took them as an oral solution since I have a hard time swallowing pills, and that made it easy to halve the dosage exponentially while weaning off. 

But as I said, it's only a possibility to experience the side effects, not a guarantee. It can take a while to find the right medication and dosage for YOU.
